entries.name: Berú of Dauntless Faith

entries.name: Berú of Desecration

detail: "It was my rage which first called demons to our world. Now I have only fear. Shadows tear at my mind by night. I must confront them. Command them!" -Jere Harash
entries.name: Berú of Harash's Shadow

entries.name: Berú of Horazon's Chains

entries.name: Berú of Iron Conviction

detail: "Kwatli, watching high above, show me what you see. Let each hand raised in evil be struck off at the wrist." -Spiritborn prayer, from the notes of Tal Rasha
entries.name: Berú of Kwatli's Grace

detail: "No amount of faith or devotion can earn the Heavens' favor, but the Light is not theirs to bestow. We were born of it just as you were—in part." -Tyrael

entries.name: Berú of Nafain's Bestiary

entries.name: Berú of Radiant Fire

detail: The ceremonial blade is bare except for a red, open eye engraved into the metal. It is heavier than it appears, as though the dagger carries the weight of every vision ever drawn from a seer's sight.
entries.name: Athame of the Eye

detail: Blessed by the spirits and handed down from father to son. The blade that proved anathema to the demon Beleth and broke the curse placed upon Dian and his family, now entrusted to you.
entries.name: Beleth's Bane

detail: Wielded for centuries of grim tyranny, as evinced by innumerable nicks and stains.
entries.name: Bitter Flamberge

detail: Champions who earn the favor of Ormus are rewarded with only the most impressive of items, the Garb of Baleful Intent. Revel in your triumph!
entries.name: Boots of Baleful Intent

detail: Champions who earn the favor of Ormus are rewarded with only the most impressive of items, the Garb of Baleful Intent. Revel in your triumph!
entries.name: Breeches of Baleful Intent

detail: A grafted bone dagger used to carve out the hearts of warriors deemed worthy by Nyamoyo. A drumming heartbeat still echoes through the hilt, remembering those it claimed.
entries.name: Claw of Nyamoyo

detail: "She hides among the trees, with eyes that never cease. A grin that spreads from cheek to cheek. If you're caught, you're hers to keep."
entries.name: Crook of the Grinning Shaman

detail: Champions who earn the favor of Ormus are rewarded with only the most impressive of items, the Garb of Baleful Intent. Revel in your triumph!
entries.name: Crown of Baleful Intent

detail: "We turn to the light of the dawn to guide our way out of the darkness." -Agmali
entries.name: Dawnbreaker

detail: An ancient Firstborn blade preserved in time by unnatural forces.
entries.name: Diluvian Blade

detail: "If they don't open the door, then we open it ourselves. Are we ready?" -Unknown Askari Guard
entries.name: Doorknocker

detail: Each twang of the bowstring emits a faint sound resembling either a chant of thanksgiving, a scream, a bitter accusation, or pious prayer.
entries.name: Echoing Whisper

detail: "When anger needs abatement, walk among the trees. When anger demands expression, plant your roots." Etsecheke, Warden of Sutsarnin
entries.name: Etsecheke's Walking Stick

detail: "Those who misprize my sisters' sacrifice deserve anathema. A fate befitting the flippant." -Achaia
entries.name: Fatecarver

detail: Champions who earn the favor of Ormus are rewarded with only the most impressive of items, the Garb of Baleful Intent. Revel in your triumph!
entries.name: Gauntlets of Baleful Intent

detail: "Our eyes met. I could tell he needed help. I could have given it. I walked away, and savored his screams for mercy."
entries.name: Hatred's Gaze

detail: "Bruises bloomed over its ribs and burst into hues of wet scarlet when the meat inside came pouring out over my boot. I had sense enough in my frenzy to ensure the thing was dead, at least."
entries.name: Hatred's March

detail: "Early in our courtship, Philios gifted me a dress of satin. I tore it in half before his eyes. The next day, he gifted me the helmet I wear now. That's when I knew he understood me." -Askarra

detail: This repurposed Zakarum battle-axe was once weilded by the Zealots of Kurast. Now it bears the blood and ashes of those who drew to close to the Burnt Knights.
entries.name: Heretic's Executioner

detail: Lightweight treads worn while rallying forces against the Helltide.
entries.name: Iron Wolves Messenger Boots

detail: "Kill only to save innocent lives, and live only to stand between the innocent and death." -Valeria
entries.name: Justiciar's Brand

detail: "For all his talk of mirrors, I never see Karcheus gaze at his own reflection. I once asked him about this and he said, 'It shows too much.'" -Philios
entries.name: Leggings of Karcheus

detail: "For all his talk of mirrors, I never see Karcheus gaze at his own reflection. I once asked him about this and he said, 'It shows too much.'" -Philios
entries.name: Leggings of Karcheus

detail: "I used to pretend to be a Horadric hero when I was a boy. Fighting monsters with my wooden sword. Feels like a long time ago." -Lorath Nahr
entries.name: Lorath's Polearm

detail: A pristine, skillfully crafted piece of armor. The helm bears the white hand of the Mercenaries.
entries.name: Mercenary Helm

detail: "Every good trickster has a reliable sidesplitter. It's guaranteed to cut through a crowd!" -Kakkos
entries.name: Mischief Maker

detail: A humble walking staff given by Bnatros. Many names are etched into the shaft, including "Ahul," "Kor," "Kela," and "Devrik."
entries.name: Pilgrim's Staff

detail: "She is a mountain—strong and beautiful, with a fury that rains fire. But, navigate that fury, and you may find she has treasures to share, like the armor I wear on my chest." -Hefaetrus
entries.name: Plackart of Hefaetrus

detail:
"I saw my corpse, and from my mouth crawled Hatred"
- Rathma's Prophecy
entries.name: Rathma's Amulet

detail: "As you journey in the Spirit Realm, you will be guided as you cull the spirits that seek to devour you." - Tarka, the Emissary
entries.name: Realmwarden's Scepter

detail: The shattered medallion you delivered to Soudeh has been expertly reassembled and burnished to gleaming. Rarely are such emblems given to outside allies of the Wolves, in thanks for heroic service.
entries.name: Reclaimed Medallion of the Iron Wolves

detail: "To Reyna. My love for you is like this ring. It has no end. - Donnell"
entries.name: Reyna's Wedding Ring

detail: A gift from Queen Tharra of Skovos, first of her name. Inscribed it reads: "To my friend who is peerless in valor, may your arm never falter."
entries.name: Scepter of Queen Tharra I

detail: Forged from a salvaged shard of enchanted brass armor worn by the nangari of Nahantu. The dark enchantments woven into it by the Ennead clan still hold their potency, even millennia later.
entries.name: Shadowclaw Slicer

detail: The blade hums faintly in your hands. It seems to be asking, no, begging for you to draw blood with it.
entries.name: Soul Taker

detail: The blade hums faintly in your hands. It seems to be asking, no, begging for you to draw blood with it.
entries.name: Soul Taker

detail: Upon pledging their life to serving the Tree of Whispers, witches of the swamp are gifted a root or branch to signify their accord.
entries.name: Staff of Whispers

detail: A medallion signifying high rank among the Knights Penitent. A true Knight would never part with it.
entries.name: Steadfast Insignia

detail: A thousand eyes peer through the Void. Their silence is the drawing of breath.
entries.name: The Stillblade

detail: Champions who earn the favor of Ormus are rewarded with only the most impressive of items, the Garb of Baleful Intent. Revel in your triumph!
entries.name: Vestment of Baleful Intent

detail:
"Through penance alone do we let the Father's light enter our sinful souls. Lay down your life for his purpose, and you shall shine brilliantly with his glory."
- Holy Words of the Father, Book VIII
entries.name: Vigo's Protecting Amulet

detail: Protection is more than defending those dear to you. It is also pummeling those who wish them harm.
entries.name: Ward-Hammer

detail: "Horror wrought from necessity is virtue... Woe to those without the strength to wield it."
entries.name: Witness to Woe

detail:
Randomly provides a Helm, Chest Armor, Gloves, Pants, or Boots with several Pacts.

Pact variants have an equal chance of appearing on items obtained in this way.
entries.name: Pact Armor

detail: This badly damaged and decayed weapon reeks of manure.
entries.name: Rusted Bardiche
